items.source: As of Spring 4.1.2, this class extends EnumerablePropertySource instead of plain PropertySource, exposing getPropertyNames() based on the accumulated property names from all contained sources - and failing with an IllegalStateException against any non-EnumerablePropertySource. When used through the EnumerablePropertySource contract, all contained sources are expected to be of type EnumerablePropertySource as well.
items.translation: 自 Spring 4.1.2 起，该类扩展了 EnumerablePropertySource 而非普通的 PropertySource，并基于所有包含源中累积的属性名称暴露了 getPropertyNames() —— 若遇到任何非 EnumerablePropertySource 类型的源，则会抛出 IllegalStateException。 当通过 EnumerablePropertySource 契约使用时，所有包含的源都预期为 EnumerablePropertySource 类型。

items.source: This implementation checks for the presence of the given name within the EnumerablePropertySource.getPropertyNames() array.
items.translation: 此实现检查给定名称是否存在于 EnumerablePropertySource.getPropertyNames() 数组中。
